name: env-example-sync
description: Keeps .env.example in sync with the environment variables your code actually reads.

file.title: Example file
file.description: Name of the example file to keep in sync, relative to the project root. Empty = .env.example, then .env.sample. Real .env files are never touched.

ignore.title: Ignored variables
ignore.description: Comma-separated variable names to leave out, on top of the built-in list (NODE_ENV, PATH, HOME, CI ...).
